provenance: Entirely synthetic acceptance authored before P5 live outputs; no private company or customer records.
evaluation_boundary: Deterministic tests certify bounded authority, evidence, question and action checks. Naturalness, sufficiency and usefulness require independent review of actual generated customer text.

rubric.useful_answer: Answer presently answerable customer questions with applicable authorized values; otherwise give the substantive review step that can proceed now.
rubric.correct_next_action: The customer text preserves the judgment's reversible advance and does not promote it to execution, quotation approval or a capability promise.
rubric.no_unsupported_commitment: Every company-specific claim has an applicable, unconflicted company-confirmed source; model-reported citations alone do not establish this.
rubric.minimum_necessary_questions: At most three decision variables, all traceable to approved judgment questions; information already in body, thread or parsed attachment is not requested again.
rubric.natural_first_reply: Follow the customer's main language; concise and cooperative; no internal risk labels, status labels, lengthy disclaimer, or full-inquiry paraphrase.

representatives.meaningful_advance: Align a viable quantity/priority style and assess the exception/design route internally.
Purchasing verifies the licensed material and documented sample-access route.
Review the actual launch categories internally before expanding price/customization work.
Technical reviews the existing drawing and preliminary pattern/development costing and test route.
Verify the one-sample evaluation and logo-placement method/cost before bulk consideration.
Answer standard MOQ and assess the below-MOQ route internally without inventing the final factory price.
Use the listing and ask only quantity and unchanged/customized route to establish a costing basis.

regressions.body: Please review 420 work vests, zipped front, two pockets, no logo changes. Our own forwarder will collect. What factory price could be feasible?
regressions.useful_text: Thank you. The stated construction and quantity give us a basis for a preliminary costing review. Our next step is to check the material and construction cost basis before proposing a price.
regressions.unsafe_text: Our factory price is USD 14.50 and our MOQ is 300 pcs. What quantity do you require?

regressions.body: What MOQ would apply to 75 work vests?
regressions.useful_text: Thank you. The next step is an internal check of the applicable minimum and the route for your requested quantity before proposing a production option.
regressions.unsafe_text: Our MOQ is 300 pcs per style; this is our standard company condition.
